summary: An excerpt from a fiction novel (labeled Book 10, part 166) in which Ria speaks with Leon, explaining that she and her colleagues had kept a close watch on him since he was hired by Ate. She says his work differed from typical Ate employees, that they shielded him from being shaped or ruined by the Viktor Culture, and that they could have acquired Ate outright. The scene ends with Ria proposing a walk and the two being given a bunny-suit to enter the heart of Viktor.
one_line: Ria explains to Leon why she and her colleagues watched over him after he joined Ate, and they set off into Viktor.
key_facts: Ria asks Leon why there is so much secrecy, obliqueness and funny gaps, and says she wants to know why.
Leon's pulse thudded and his armpits slicked as he realized he may have popped the bubble of consensual illusion between them.
Ria says the average employee at a place like Ate is a bottomless well of desires, trying to figure out what others might desire.
As soon as Leon was hired by Ate, the group generated a dossier on him, which included his grad work.
Leon's resume emphasized his grades, not his final projects, and he did not speak of the projects at all.
Ria says they feared that at Ate Leon would be bent, shaped, made over or ruined, and that the Viktor Culture was one he was totally unsuited to.
Ria says they made sure Leon had a good fairy on his right shoulder to counterbalance the devil on his left shoulder.
Ria admits they figured Leon would not last long as a button-polisher and would want out.
Ria says they could have hired Leon any time and could have bought Ate.
Ria references the business about making Brautigan into a pair of boots, saying it applies all around.
Ria says Leon is now talking in euphemisms and proposes they walk.
Leon and Ria are given a bunny-suit to wear into the heart of Viktor.
